versions.content: Handling if attempts to add a reception secure association at an PHY and to enable or disable this secure association has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecAddRxSa was called for an EthTrcvConfig with EthTrcv- MacSecEnabled set to TRUE and the attempts to add a reception secure association and to enable or disable this reception secure association for the corresponding PHY has been successfully finalized, then the EthTrcv driver shall notify the EthIf by call- ing EthIf_MacSecAddRxSaNotification with CtrlIdx set to the corresponding EthIfController and Result set to E_OK . Otherwise the EthTrcv driver shall call EthIf_MacSecAddRxSaNotification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
